shortDescription: Bitcoin could trigger $1.29 billion in cumulative short liquidations on major centralized exchanges if it breaks above $84,356. According to ChainCatcher, Coinglass data also shows that if BTC falls below $76,969, cumulative long liquidations on major CEXs would reach $852 million.
